name: Official provenance and schema
rule: Every factual input has an official source link; unknowns stay blank; integrity checks pass.
policy_label: Analyst governance choice informed by cited methods

name: Frozen pre-registration and trial count
rule: Rules/thresholds and the complete comparable trial family are hashed before outcome evaluation.
policy_label: Analyst governance choice informed by cited methods

name: Point-in-time leakage audit
rule: Walk-forward features use only information available before the archived decision; no future data or survivor substitution.
policy_label: Analyst governance choice informed by cited methods

name: Power and effective sample size
rule: Predeclared economically meaningful effect reaches >=80% exact/dependence-aware power with adequate independent settlement clusters.
evidence: No settled bets or independent settlement clusters
policy_label: Analyst governance choice informed by cited methods

name: Dependence and exact joint pricing
rule: The actual legs' joint distribution is validated; shared games/overlaps and pushes/voids are handled; no blind marginal multiplication.
evidence: No validated joint model for actual offered legs
policy_label: Analyst governance choice informed by cited methods

name: Out-of-sample market calibration
rule: Frozen holdout probabilities beat the applicable no-vig market benchmark on paired log loss/Brier with uncertainty.
evidence: No frozen out-of-sample market calibration ledger
policy_label: Analyst governance choice informed by cited methods

name: Net economics and uncertainty
rule: Timestamped prices, fees, voids and settlement yield a positive lower uncertainty bound on net ROI; CLV is recorded separately.
evidence: No executable/settled prices, ROI or CLV
policy_label: Analyst governance choice informed by cited methods

name: Selection-bias control
rule: Holm-adjusted primary tests plus DSR>=0.95 with full effective trial count; CSCV/PBO<=0.50 when a valid trial matrix exists.
evidence: No full trial-return matrix, DSR or PBO evidence
policy_label: Analyst governance choice informed by cited methods

name: Prospective replication and execution
rule: A predeclared live/paper window replicates the result with auditable quotes and decisions; no retroactive rule changes.
evidence: No prospective replication or execution audit
policy_label: Analyst governance choice informed by cited methods

name: Reproducible fail-closed release
rule: Deterministic build, tests, links and review flags pass; missing evidence blocks certification rather than filling values.
evidence: Deterministic engine/build checks; certification still requires all other gates
policy_label: Analyst governance choice informed by cited methods
